videos.title: GM Slides as CEO Barra Warns of ‘Intensifying’ Challenges
videos.description: General Motors Co. shares fell as shareholders focused on a narrower profit outlook despite plans for another $20 billion in stock repurchases. The company now sees 2026 adjusted earnings before interest and taxes in a range of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion, compared with the $14 billion to $16 billion range it projected in July. videos.title: AI Neoclouds Lose Their Shine, Stalling IPOs and Sinking Stocks
videos.description: The tide is turning on neoclouds, a business segment that’s emerged over the past few years to supply the vast amounts of data center computing needed to power artificial intelligence systems.The latest evidence that investors are losing faith: Elice Inc., a South Korean AI computing supplier scarcely known outside its home market until this week, tanked 32% in its debut in Seoul Tuesday. Bloomberg's Mandeep Singh breaks it down on Bloomberg Intelligence. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
